en.headline: Police arrest taxi driver after two Britons suffer head injuries in Wan Chai
en.dek: A 65-year-old man and a 58-year-old woman were struck while crossing Hennessy Road early Sunday; the driver faces a dangerous driving allegation.
body: Police arrested a taxi driver on suspicion of dangerous driving after his vehicle hit two British nationals early on Sunday in Wan Chai.

The incident occurred at about 1:39am near Hay Wah Building. The victims, a 65-year-old man and a 58-year-old woman, were crossing Hennessy Road when the taxi travelling west struck them. Both suffered head injuries and were taken to Queen Mary Hospital. The man was semi-conscious on arrival but later recovered consciousness; the woman remained conscious.
Police said the driver was uninjured. Officers are continuing enquiries into the circumstances of the collision.

zh.headline: 灣仔的士撞傷兩名英籍遊客 司機涉危險駕駛被捕
zh.dek: 一名65歲男子及58歲女子凌晨在軒尼詩道過路時被撞，頭部受傷送院，的士司機被警方拘捕。
body: 警方拘捕一名的士司機，涉嫌危險駕駛，事緣其車輛周日凌晨在灣仔撞傷兩名英籍人士。
事件約於凌晨1時39分在希華大廈附近發生。兩名傷者分別為65歲男子及58歲女子，當時正橫過軒尼詩道，被西行的士撞倒。兩人頭部受傷，送往瑪麗醫院。男子抵院時半昏迷，其後恢復意識；女子一直清醒。
警方表示司機未有受傷。案件仍在調查中。
